meta.method: A company that runs centres in more than one city counts once in the national and global totals, and appears in the count for each of those cities. So the city figures add up to more than the national total, and no company is counted twice within one city.

scope_note.Delhi NCR: Gurugram, Noida, New Delhi, Greater Noida, Manesar and Faridabad together: 482 GCCs. Adding up the city figures gives 540, because some GCCs have offices in more than one of these cities.

industry.label: Industry
industry.note: Each GCC is classified into exactly one industry, so these add up to the total.

generation.label: Generation (maturity)
generation.note: GCCPROs maturity model. Gen 1 runs support and back-office work; Gen 2 owns delivery for a function; Gen 3 owns products, engineering or a global process end to end; Gen 4 holds global P&L or decision rights.

domain.label: Domain (function run)
domain.note: Most GCCs run several functions, so a centre appears under every domain it operates. These deliberately add up to more than the total.
